title: Kaldewei: Milestones of corporate history | KALDEWEI
content: **From small business to a global partner for high-end bathroom solutions: the KALDEWEI brand history is also a success story. The premium supplier of shower surfaces, bathtubs and enamelled washbasins manufactures solely at its corporate headquarters in Germany, and its facilities are the most advanced in the world. The unique material, KALDEWEI steel enamel, is not only at the core of the brand but is also the reason for the success of every product over decades.**. Over the course of almost 100 years, the company founded in Ahlen by Franz KALDEWEI in October 1918 has developed from being a small business into one of the leading manufacturers of steel enamel bathroom solutions. This is the period during which KALDEWEI makes its name as a pioneer in the development and manufacturing of enamelled shower trays and bathtubs – a reputation it has maintained right up to the present day.

Made in Ahlen, Germany. For over 100 years and now in the fourth generation, we have been dedicated to our DNA, KALDEWEI steel enamel. Whether shower surface, bathtub or washbasin, steel enamel is our raw material, and passion is what drives us: for the greatest precision, for a timeless aesthetic and for the technical challenges that we master as pioneers. From our high-tech production site in Germany, we bring our iconic bathroom solutions into the world. Join Carsten Voß (Senior Vice President International Sales) and Martin Rowell (International Project Manager Europe) and find out more about KALDEWEI.

title: Company | KALDEWEI
content: KALDEWEI is a German **family company** that has been creating bathroom solutions combining modern luxury with sustainable thinking, management and action for **over 100 years** and which is now **in its fourth generation**. The KALDEWEI portfolio includes bathtubs, shower surfaces and washbasins made from exquisite **steel enamel**. In 2021, KALDEWEI was the first sanitary company to sign the **“Science Based Targets”** and set out to produce in a climate-neutral way. As a leading international manufacturer of high-quality shower surfaces, bathtubs and washbasins made of superior steel enamel, KALDEWEI is represented in more than 80 countries including 12 subsidiaries in Austria, China, Czech Republic, France, Italy, Poland, Russia, Switzerland, Southeast Asia, Spain, the UK and the USA. The fact that sustainability is a central issue at KALDEWEI is not only underlined by the fight against plastic in the bathroom and the partnership with the environmental protection organization WWF.
